title: Glass Merchant Software | Cut-to-Size, Processing & Trade Counter | Coglass
description: Coglass runs a glass merchant's whole operation — trade counter, cut-to-size webshop, processing & production, stock, trade accounts, collections and deliveries. Built for how glass is sold and made.
eyebrow: For glass merchants, processors & sealed unit makers
lead: From the trade counter to the toughening line, Coglass runs a glass merchant's day: quick counter quotes, cut-to-size orders online, the processing board, stock, trade accounts and route-planned deliveries — priced the way glass is actually sold.
steps_h2: From counter to collection — the merchant's day
steps_sub: Coglass runs the whole flow a glass merchant works through, on one system.
inc_h2: Everything a glass merchant runs on
inc_sub: The counter, the factory and the office on one live system.
steps: Counter, phone, email — or a branded webshop where trade customers reorder cut-to-size on their own agreed prices. Quick Go builds a walk-in quote or order in seconds.
Per-m² and per-unit pricing with trade price-lists, quantity breaks and per-customer accounts. No retyping rate cards — the right price applies automatically.
Full IGU make-ups (DGU/TGU, cavity, spacer, gas), edges, shapes and operations — with the spacer/cavity captured per line, never baked into the product.

The production board tracks every order through the shop with barcode scan from cut to ready. Make each operation in-house or send it out as outwork — Coglass raises the processing order automatically.
Collection orders with a signature at the counter, or delivery runs planned on the board, with the route on a map for cut glass — because not everything gets fitted.
Deposits, proformas, UK VAT and account invoicing, pushed to Xero, with overdue invoices flagged automatically.
included: Trade counter (Quick Go)
Walk-in quotes, orders and collection signing in seconds.
Branded trade webshop
Trade customers reorder cut-to-size online on their agreed prices and pay by card.
Trade accounts & price lists
Per-customer and per-type pricing, quantity breaks and contract windows, applied automatically.
Full glass specification
IGU make-ups, edges, shapes, Georgian / lead / diamond, holes and cut-outs — cavity captured per line.
Processing & production board
Track every order through production on one board, with each operation made in-house or bought in from a processor.
Stock & jumbo sheets
Mark products as held in stock, order jumbo packs from suppliers and see the profit on each cut — with optional live stock levels.
Cut-to-size ordering
Size, spec and quantity captured cleanly and priced live.
Collections & deliveries
Collection signing at the counter plus delivery runs planned on the board — not just fitting.
Supplier orders
Raise and chase purchase orders; AI reads supplier price-list PDFs into live prices.
Barcode labels & scanning
Label every piece and scan it from cut to ready to received.
Invoicing, deposits & Xero
Proformas, UK VAT, account terms and overdue flagging, synced to Xero.
One system, no silos
Counter, factory and office working from the same live data.
cta_h2: Run your glass merchant business from one app
cta_p: Book a demo and we'll walk you through it on the kind of jobs you do — or pick a plan and start a 14-day trial.
